purpose: Freeze the observable state of the existing Supabase capacity-test development branch before any authorized recovery/reset. This file is evidence, not a backup and not a migration.

acquisition.mode: Supabase metadata/list APIs plus read-only SELECT statements

migration_ledger.canonical_serialization: version + US + name + US + statement_count + US + statement_bytes + US + statements_sha256 + US + rollback_sha256; rows joined by RS in ascending serialized order

branch_only.name: capacity_test_reusable_cleaned_prefix
branch_only.credential_or_email_screen: no email-like text, credential terms, or auth-user INSERT detected

data_evidence.hash_algorithm: sha256(concat in deterministic key order of sha256(jsonb_text(sanitized row)))

critical_observations: The target is a persistent non-default development branch whose parent is the production project; the project refs and API endpoints are distinct.
The branch database is reachable and ACTIVE_HEALTHY while the branch deployment status is MIGRATIONS_FAILED.
Nine capacity runs are cleaned and one run remains preparing; every capacity-test agent is idle and no agent has a recorded heartbeat.
The branch ledger is severely divergent from production: four common versions, one branch-only version, and 150 production-only versions.
PGMQ metadata, cron.job, coletas_producao, collection_processing_attempts, collection_projection_outbox, and feature_flags are absent.
No waiting locks and no idle-in-transaction sessions were observed at the final preflight snapshot.
Reset is destructive to untracked branch data/schema; this manifest preserves sanitized summaries and deterministic hashes but is not a recoverable database backup.

excluded: raw audit old/new values, metadata, logs, stacks, and user agents
person identifiers from agent, metric, error, command, and audit exports
sanitization.vault_policy: Names only; no secret values. The branch had zero Vault secret-name rows at capture.
sanitization.hash_scope: Capacity hashes use explicitly sanitized JSON projections. Fixture hashes are deterministic database-side digests only; fixture row contents are not exported. The audit hash uses a sanitized field projection.

official_references.title: Supabase: Working with branches
official_references.relevance: Branches have isolated database/API/Auth/Storage/Edge state; branch data is temporary and resets/recreation lose additional data.

official_references.title: Supabase: Branching troubleshooting
official_references.relevance: Failed migrations should be diagnosed from deployment logs and migrations rerun sequentially after correcting migration state.
